business_summary.text: Banka BioLoo operates as an integrated water and sanitation services platform through Banka Bio (execution) and Megaliter (funding and contracting), building and operating treatment plants with long-term service contracts.

call_points.text: FY27 focus on converting contracted revenues into cash through commissioning, billing and collections
₹122 Cr LTV portfolio with 16 contracted projects represents long-term recurring revenue opportunity
Project EBITDA margin at ~60%, focus on making underlying improvement repeatable in FY27
2030 vision targets 15+ billion litres annual water recycling
Management expects continued growth in FY27 with a focus on margin expansion and profitability
12-M order book stands at ₹107 Cr, with a robust pipeline under negotiation

exceptions: loan to promoter group: ₹2.8639 Cr outstanding
guarantee or comfort to promoter group: ₹23.85 Cr outstanding

guidance.statement: Path to profitability for the next FY
Convert contracted revenues into cash through commissioning, billing and collections

operating_notes.text: 12-M order book stands at ₹107 Cr, with unexecuted orders at ₹82 Cr
Q4FY26 new orders in WaSH segment: ~₹16 Cr
Expanded into Bangalore and Mumbai with projects from Brigade, Reliance and RMZ
FY26 other income includes ₹0.84 crore of award income, not customer subscription revenue
Working capital absorbed ₹6.10 Cr of operating cash flow in FY26
14 projects operating, 2 under WIP in the ₹122 Cr LTV portfolio

timeline.summary: Banka BioLoo reported FY26 results with a turnaround to profitability, revenue growth of 10% YoY, and a strong order book of ₹107 Cr.
Banka BioLoo FY26 results show earnings recovery with ₹6.49 Cr EBITDA and ₹0.39 Cr PAT, now focusing on converting ₹122 Cr LTV portfolio into cash in FY27.
